title: prototype-knowledge
proposition: Compile bounded AI context without allowing generated information to become authority.
story: prototype-knowledge is a machine-readable knowledge registry and AI context compiler. Its Python CLI validates structured decisions, contracts, lessons and provenance, retrieves deterministic subsets and compiles bounded context for AI-assisted engineering.
contribution: I designed the provenance and authority model, implemented dependency-free validation and structured retrieval, compiled selected knowledge into multiple representations and established governance and append-only history checks.

reflection.summary: Useful AI context needs more than retrieval. It must preserve provenance, distinguish durable knowledge from generated candidates and leave final acceptance with a human authority.

limitations: The repository is private and its packaging is intentionally incomplete.
The runtime validator does not enforce every declared JSON Schema or query option.
The project does not implement autonomous learning, repository mutation, an MCP server or a decision-ledger runtime.

provenance.description: Mechanically derived from the controlling public projection.
